propositions: The code-review gate declares per-step model classes on all five LLM-calling steps, but every declaration is silently ignored at runtime, with all calls executing on a single cfg.model instead
PydanticAIRunner.run discards req.config.model and resolves models only from self._config, causing per-step model declarations wired through RunnerAgentStep to be lost before execution
Usage logging lacks step attribution, making it impossible to distinguish which workflow step produced which LLM call when multiple steps use the same prompt name
The same runner-level model-discard defect affects plan-review's prerequisite ladder escalation, verifier config override, and completion gate per-call configurations
Step 0 requires threading step identity and raw declared model tokens via ContextVar through to usage_log.record() to enable observability for all downstream per-call routing diagnostics
